lines.en: I follow you from a long way off.
I'm walking behind that tree over there.
I watched you from afar a long while.
I walk along the edge of the roof.

lines.zh: 站在远处看，就已经够了。
lines.en: Watching from a distance is already enough.
I circle ahead to the crossing.
I don't come closer; I only follow.
I move parallel to you on the hillside.

lines.zh: 我在你的屋顶边缘走，你看不见。
lines.en: I walk the roof's edge where you cannot see.
I stay outside your field of view.
The moment you look up, I stop.
I change direction and approach again.
I stand on the ridge and watch.
I do nothing but watch.
How many times have you looked back?
I've been watching a long while.
You can't make out my face, can you?
I'm standing under that tree.
You sat down, so I sat down.
At this distance I see best.
Your fire has burned low.

lines.zh: 我从来不眨眼，也睡不着。
lines.en: I never blink, and I never sleep.
Who are you talking to?
I stand far off and watch a long while.

lines.zh: 我记住了你每天做什么。
lines.en: I've learned what you do each day.
It's dark now, and I'm still here.
I have watched from the corner a long while.

lines.zh: 我在这里站了两个时辰。
lines.en: I've stood here for two hours.
You looked almost the right way.
I can see your shadow clearly.

lines.zh: 我数过你今天走了几步。
lines.en: I counted the steps you took today.
When do you close your door?
I'm twenty blocks from you.

lines.zh: 你手里那个东西从没放下过。
lines.en: You've never put that thing down.
You roll onto your left when you sleep.
I have never come close.
Don't wave; I won't respond.

lines.zh: 你笑的样子我记住了，远远地。
lines.en: I remember your smile, from far off.
Go far, and I'll still be here.

lines.zh: 我知道你今晚会去哪里。
lines.en: I know where you'll go tonight.

lines.zh: 你走路的样子，我记下了。
lines.en: I have memorized how you walk.

lines.zh: 我从上面看过你的营地。
lines.en: I've seen your camp from above.
While you watch, I don't move.

lines.zh: 这块地形我记得比你清。
lines.en: I know this terrain better than you do.
I circle you from a distance, watching.
Next time I'll be a little closer.

lines.zh: 我退开了，还站在能看见的地方。
lines.en: I've pulled back, still within sight.
You shouldn't have struck me.
I turn, and soon I'm far away.
My position is exposed.
I've moved to the other side.

lines.zh: 我记下了你抬手的高度。
lines.en: I noted how high your hand went.
I lowered my head.
You look at me, and I retreat.
That was close enough to see.
I've returned to the hillside.
I won't take what you set down.
Turn your head, and I back away.
Leave that on the ground.
I only need to watch.
Even if you throw it, I won't catch.
I don't eat your food.

lines.zh: 你摆这个是想让我过去？
lines.en: Are you setting that out to draw me in?
I won't fall for that.
You left it by the door.
It'll still be there tomorrow.
You bumped into me — that's rare.
I withdraw at once.
You shouldn't have come this way.
I touch you, and you feel nothing.
You touched my arm.
From afar, I watch you walk away.
That ruined my position.
Don't follow me; I should go.

lines.zh: 你回头看一眼，我已经远了。
lines.en: Look back, and I'm already far.
I was careless this time.

lines.zh: 另一双眼睛在另一边的山脊。
lines.en: Another pair of eyes on the far ridge.

lines.zh: 我们隔着整片山谷对望。
lines.en: We look across the whole valley.
It's watching the same person.
We needn't be closer.

lines.zh: 它记住了左边的路，我记住右边。
lines.en: It memorized the left path; I took the right.
We swapped positions.

lines.zh: 这样一直看下去也不错。
lines.en: Watching on like this is fine.
Between us there is nothing at all.

lines.zh: 两个影子在山坡上，一动不动。
lines.en: Two figures on the hillside, motionless.
At dawn we each withdraw.
I pick it up, look, and put it down.
You dropped this.

lines.zh: 我把它放在你必经的路上。
lines.en: I set it on the path you'll take.
I hold it long; it stays cold.
I hold it for a long time.
I hang it on that branch.
Your fingerprints are on this.

lines.zh: 我捡起它，照你的样子用。
lines.en: I pick it up and use it as you do.

lines.zh: 我想知道它是做什么的。
lines.en: I want to know what it's for.
You'll notice when you get home.
You're heading the wrong way today.
I've marked you.
You're too far from your camp.
I'm watching you.
You stop here; so do I.
Something on you is missing.
Something is waiting over there.
I've followed all day.
You're looking for a way; I know it.
Looking back won't help.
I want to see what you do.
You're starting to panic.
You turn, and you see me.

lines.zh: 我把你的位置记在脑子里。
lines.en: I keep your position in mind.
I'm only fifteen blocks away.
There's a cliff behind you.
I've moved to another tree.
Look up, and I'm gone.

lines.zh: 我在你的左侧，一直没动。
lines.en: I've been at your left, unmoving.
You're walking that way — good.
I follow your footprints.
Your prints are getting shallower.
I crouch to look at your fire pit.
I've noted where you gather wood.
Further on is your camp.
Which block will you sleep in tonight?
I counted your arrows.

lines.zh: 你拐过两个路口，我仍在。
lines.en: Two corners later, I am still here.

lines.zh: 你看向哪边，我就换哪边。
lines.en: Where you look, I move opposite.
I've been watching from afar.
I've closed five blocks.
You're walking faster now.
I can keep up; no hurry.

lines.zh: 你回头看的次数变多了。
lines.en: You're looking back more often.
I'm on the slope behind you.

lines.zh: 这个距离我已经很熟悉。
lines.en: I know this distance well.
I'm behind you now.
I haven't touched you.

lines.zh: 你摔下去的时候我没动。
lines.en: I didn't move when you fell.

lines.zh: 我伸手，只是把你推了半步。
lines.en: I reach out and only push you half a step.
You turn, and there's nothing.
Your hand swings through empty air.
I didn't mean to take this step.
I caught your shoulder once.
Do you hear the grass rustling?
I've withdrawn, and you didn't see.
You're still standing there.
Your torch fell to the ground.
I passed against your back.
I let my shadow show this time.
I reach out and touch your shoulder.
After this step, I leave.
I've appeared on the ridge.
I can see very well from here.

lines.zh: 我先看你，再看你的营地。
lines.en: First I look at you, then at your camp.
I don't intend to come down.
I rest a hand on the tree.
You haven't noticed me yet.
The wind carries my scent away.

lines.zh: 我数了数你身边有几个人。
lines.en: I count how many are with you.
It's early; I have plenty of time.
I stand there, and keep standing.

lines.zh: 有一道影子落在石头上。
lines.en: A shadow falls across the stone.
I lift one hand.
From the roof I found my angle.
I watch you from the treeline.

lines.zh: 你走的那条路我看得见。
lines.en: I can see the path you're on.

lines.zh: 我在这里，一点声都不出。
lines.en: I'm here, without a sound.

lines.zh: 我开始记你的一举一动。
lines.en: I begin recording your every move.
Go on ahead; I'll follow.
This time I'll watch longer.
I'm standing under that dead tree.

lines.zh: 火照亮了我，我不得不退。
lines.en: The fire lit me up and I had to withdraw.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，草盖住了我。
lines.en: I rolled down the slope and the grass covered me.
The water leaves me unable to see the way.

lines.zh: 响声把我的位置全暴露了。
lines.en: The blast exposed my position entirely.

lines.zh: 箭擦过我的脸，我停了很久。
lines.en: The arrow grazed my face, and I froze a long while.
That light leaves me nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 我很久没吃东西了，但还是看着。
lines.en: I haven't eaten in ages, and I keep watching.
The flash sends me flat into the grass.

lines.zh: 什么都看不见了，我还在看。
lines.en: I can see nothing at all, and I keep looking.
